description: Gnomon Labs: a web app that compares south pole landing sites by Sun and Earth visibility above the horizon, to help plan power and communication windows. Built solo as a focused 48-hour MVP. Stack: TypeScript, React/Next.js, astronomy-engine and Recharts for the app, Vitest for tests, and Python with Skyfield to validate results against JPL ephemerides. The write-up will document how AI tools were used.
